tool_args.rationale: The response is monotone and concave across the pilot, but the last point approaches the reported critical gradient range (~2.50–2.68). A high_sgrad_regime_probe directly tests for the predicted avalanche drop before fitting a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a smooth concave or Haldane/Cobb–Douglas model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations cover only s_grad up to 2.44, near the cited avalanche threshold; they cannot distinguish continued smooth saturation from a threshold sink.
The key uncertainty is behavior beyond the threshold, so a targeted high-s_grad observation is more discriminating and cheaper.
It is irrelevant to the identified threshold ambiguity.
